Enjoy The Evergreen Kannada Melody “Ravi Neenu Aagasadinda” From The Classic Kannada Movie Hosa Belaku, Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha, With Music Composed By M. Ranga Rao.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Beautiful Classic Song. Listen To Timeless Kannada Melodies And Memorable Hits.
Produced By: S. A. Srinivas, Sadanand, Rajashekar, Shivaram
Director By: Dorai–Bhagavan
Artist Name: Dr.RajKumar, Saritha
Music Director: M. Ranga Rao
Banner: Kathyayini Cine Art Combines
Song: Ravi Neenu Aagasadida
